name: ID
meaning: Capital letters and digits in parts joined by hyphens, starting with a letter: its scope's ID, a hyphen and its own code.

name: Title
meaning: The record's name in a few words; never blank.

name: Statement
meaning: The rule or requirement in full, with MUST, SHOULD or MAY; never blank.
example: A tool MUST NOT have two active loans.

name: Position
meaning: Its place among its siblings, from 1.

name: Path
meaning: The path a step is on: main for the main path, or another name such as refused; never blank.

name: Identifier
meaning: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

name: Subdomain type
meaning: core, supporting or generic.

name: Role
meaning: root or child.

name: Type
meaning: text, whole number, decimal, date, time, date and time, or yes/no.

name: Storage
meaning: table, view, materialized view, browser storage, file or in memory.

name: Type
meaning: primary, unique, foreign or index.

name: Method
meaning: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.

name: Delivery
meaning: in process or outbox.

name: Level
meaning: How it runs, cheapest first: unit, integration, service, system or browser. A manual test names the level a person exercises.

name: State
meaning: automated, manual or not automated yet.

name: File
meaning: The file that runs it, from the repo root; required when automated.

name: Manual reason
meaning: Why a person runs it; given when manual, and only then.

name: Type
meaning: text, integer, boolean or date.

name: Stage
meaning: domain-model, use-cases, interaction-design, technical-specification or test-plan.

name: Role
meaning: design or proof.

name: Group
meaning: The heading as first written; two groups are one when they are equal trimmed and in any letter case.

name: Name
meaning: Lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, such as too-many-children.

name: Severity
meaning: error, warning, or error_or_warning when the check's query says which for each row.

name: Max children
meaning: The most children of one kind a record should hold: a whole number of at least 1.

name: Keys
meaning: One chord, or chords separated by spaces for a sequence, each its modifiers then one key joined by +; Mod is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.

name: Values
meaning: Each token's value by its name in the app's token table, as a JSON object.

name: Format
meaning: Always "lathe-theme".

name: Version
meaning: The file format's version, 1.

name: Name
meaning: The theme's name, 1 to 60 characters.

name: Light
meaning: The light set's token values.

name: Dark
meaning: The dark set's token values.

name: Tokens
meaning: Token values shared by both modes.

name: X
meaning: Its left edge, in screen points.

name: Y
meaning: Its top edge, in screen points.

name: Width
meaning: In screen points.

name: Height
meaning: In screen points.

name: Maximized
meaning: Whether it was maximized.

name: Full screen
meaning: Whether it was full screen.

name: Background
meaning: An opaque hex color for the window's background.

name: Foreground
meaning: An opaque hex color for the window's controls.

name: Path
meaning: The page's path: a record's bare ID, a group's place in the graph's tree, or one of the app's own pages.

name: Stage
meaning: The stage shown, named only in the `stage` query parameter.

name: Stage
meaning: graph, erd or trace.

name: Layout
meaning: tree or nested.

name: Depth
meaning: How many levels below the focus the camera frames, 1 to 3.

name: Minimap
meaning: Whether the minimap shows.

name: Hidden kinds
meaning: The kinds the filters hide.

name: Wiki card
meaning: Whether the wiki card is open.

name: Wiki card width
meaning: The wiki card's width in pixels, 360 to 900, or none for a third of the open space.

name: Limit
meaning: The most entities an aggregate should hold.
